hypothesis: A hard four-state local RG code retains positive separated-shell information beyond the best validation-selected analytic two-bit code at both cold and warm beta.
metric: cold paired held-out InfoNCE gain over frozen best analytic code (nats)
discovery: Cold training only. With two independent starts per arm, rank by min(validation bound, gain over best analytic, paired minus shuffled). Rank ties by earliest round/seed. No test selection.
scheduling: Forced round-robin through 24 depth x sampling x sector x raw-gap arms on rounds not 3 mod 4; repeat the current validation champion's arm otherwise. Refit on independent training parent/anchor batches and initializations. Stop at 96 rounds or external deadline. Round 0: 10 epochs, 2048 parents per epoch. Rounds 1-31: 24 x 6144; 32-63: 36 x 10240; 64-95: 64 x 10240. An epoch uses distinct training parents, not new physical configurations.
primary: Before scoring test data, persist the selected round, weights digest, code, critic, competitor and its critic, and orientation/label alignment. At EACH of indices 9 and 7 require learned bound, paired gain, and paired-minus-off-diagonal null all >0 by simultaneous intervals. Index 0 is diagnostic only. Confirmation does not select between geometries, seeds or analytic competitors.
uncertainty: Two-sided t intervals over disjoint groups of 64 whole parents (same negative sets, 12 anchors averaged within each group); pointwise 95% and Bonferroni 1-.05/(6*3), six endpoints and three primary lanes. Conditional on fit. Frozen shuffled scores average all off-diagonal assignments in the same negative pool.
training: Maximize the exact categorical expectation of 64-way discrete InfoNCE, then discretize by argmax. Refit identical 24-hidden-unit critics on hard codes with identical initialization, number of updates, and ordered batches for all final competitors. The depth-two encoder sees only eight hard applications of its frozen first encoder, trained on its own separated small-block shell.
sampling: A one-step 2-cube or a two-step 4-cube made from eight disjoint 2-cubes at stride 2. For the same local operator a translation-covariant sliding map evaluates every raw origin, while a true partition restricts origins to a fixed raw grid of pitch 2 or 4. The registered confirmation also maps the SAME weights under both output pitches, keeping raw supports identical. Only the discovery-selected pitch enters primary inference.
shell: Ordered 6 faces x 2x2 patches x (species A,B) densities. At depth 1 each patch is one site, at depth 2 each is a 2-cube. Gaps of 1 or 2 empty raw-lattice layers; check minimum-image separation of every visible/environment raw-site pair. Same target and critic architecture for all competitors in an arm. Gains across different targets are not differences of physical MIs.
sector: Inputs to unconstrained categorical network are signed species dipoles (three ordered Cartesian components), signed checkerboard species contrasts, or cubic-invariant species counts and distance-resolved same-species pair counts. Nonlinear categorical labels need not transform as a linear irrep. Report both unrotated and cube-oriented label alignment; pick the permutation/orientation only on validation.
fixed: Opposite-corner two-bit indicators of each species including vacancy, thresholded composition counts, checkerboard vacancy/occupancy contrast, surface occupancy weighted by exposed bonds, and block energy closure. Calibrate thresholds only on training components and freeze across beta. Integer ties may leave some states empty; state histograms reported.
energy: Block-only closure of occupied-site (coordination-preferred)^2, with missing nearest neighbors independent Bernoulli at training occupancy density; includes conditional variance. Preferred counts are 3 for A and 5 for B. No buffer or halo inputs.
finite_size: One L=20 box size. FFT includes contact and overlapping supports; only disjoint buffered minimum-image lags enter the reported connected correlators. Report axis-resolved connected trace, signed eigenvalues of whitened symmetrized connected state matrices, and nonzero-wavevector structure factor. These diagnostics use 48 whole parents per temperature, not sites as independent samples. Tiled second scale side 5 has no exact Nyquist checkerboard mode. No power law, asymptotic length, thermodynamic order parameter or RG fixed point can be inferred.
optimality: InfoNCE is a lower bound on MI. A comparison of matched bounds is not a comparison of exact MIs.
